symptoms.title: Small dark spots
symptoms.description: Small dark-brown or reddish spots may appear on the leaf.

symptoms.title: Streak development
symptoms.description: Spots can expand into longer dark streaks parallel to the leaf veins.

symptoms.title: Leaf necrosis
symptoms.description: Large areas of the leaf may turn brown and dry out as the disease progresses.

symptoms.title: Premature leaf drying
symptoms.description: Severely affected leaves may lose their green color and dry prematurely.

treatment.title: Remove severely affected leaves
treatment.description: Remove severely infected leaves to reduce the amount of infected plant material.

treatment.title: Improve field sanitation
treatment.description: Remove fallen or heavily infected leaves and keep the area around banana plants clean.

treatment.title: Disease management
treatment.description: Follow locally recommended fungicide and disease-management practices when appropriate.

prevention.title: Remove infected leaves
prevention.description: Remove severely infected leaves and dispose of them properly to reduce sources of infection.

prevention.title: Improve airflow
prevention.description: Maintain adequate spacing and airflow around plants to help reduce conditions favorable to disease development.

prevention.title: Maintain sanitation
prevention.description: Keep the plantation clean and remove heavily infected plant debris.

prevention.title: Monitor leaves regularly
prevention.description: Inspect banana leaves regularly so new symptoms can be detected and managed early.
